objects.name: Analytic 2046
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies iptables/nftables rule changes on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux gateways that selectively block one ICS communication traffic type. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; command line invokes iptables/nftables to change ICS traffic filtering or redirection outside the authorized network-administration baseline

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time threshold beyond the expected communication interval that constitutes a gap warranting investigation.
